typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Destination as string (),
	Destination_File_Name as string (),
	End_Date as timestamp (),
	Start_Date as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		CampaignID as string,
		{Effective Date} as timestamp,
		{Family link} as string,
		{Scrub Reason} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from ##DC_AutomateScrub',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SubscriberID} = SubscriberID,
		{Copy of CampaignID} = CampaignID) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of Effective Date} as double,
		{Copy of Family link} as string,
		{Copy of CampaignID} as string,
		{Copy of SubscriberID} as string,
		{Copy of Scrub Reason} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
